answer: Random jury sampling at the nadir of trust: 9 seats drawn without replacement, so a farm holding fraction k of identities captures a full jury only k^9 of the time. The garden of honest keys is the signal — stake-weighted key-value registry where each identity maps to one locked key. A 30% attacker wins 0.3^9 ≈ 0.00002, so forgery costs far exceed any payout. Verdicts stay honest.
